name: Fetch WaSOS images & upload to Rayvn
info: For each entry with files: fetches binary from WaSOS, uploads to Rayvn /files endpoint, and attaches Rayvn file IDs to the entry. Entries without files pass through unchanged.

name: Init processing
info: Initialize iteration variables for processing entries with files.

name: Process current entry
info: Check if current entry has files. Output 1: has files (proceed to fetch). Output 2: no files (skip to done check).

name: Prepare WaSOS file fetch
info: Build HTTP request to fetch binary file from WaSOS. Output 1: fetch file. Output 2: skip to finalize (on error).

name: GET WaSOS file (binary)
info: Fetch binary file data from WaSOS. IMPORTANT: Return type must be 'a binary buffer'.

name: Prepare Rayvn upload (multipart)
info: Build multipart/form-data request for Rayvn file upload. Output 1: upload to Rayvn. Output 2: finalize entry (on WaSOS fetch failure).

name: POST to Rayvn /files
info: Upload file to Rayvn /files endpoint. Returns FileDTO with id.

name: Handle Rayvn response
info: Process Rayvn upload response. Extract file ID. Output 1: more files to process (loop). Output 2: all files done (finalize).

name: Finalize entry
info: Store Rayvn file IDs on entry, clean up temp variables, advance to next entry.

name: Check if done
info: Check if more entries to process. Output 1: more entries (loop). Output 2: all done (subflow output).
